title: Five Messages We All Need to Hear
author: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf
author_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

footnotes.text: In one of His final discourses in mortality, Jesus taught His disciples what would happen at the Final Judgment, explaining that our eternal future will depend largely upon how we have treated others (seeMatthew 25:31–40).
